source.description: Main classes and subclasses from the LC Classification Outline; numbered spans and captions from the 2024 FreeLCC outline PDFs; LCSH links from id.loc.gov subject headings whose LCC number is exactly a class's number or span. A span's code is `<start>-<end>` with the end's letters dropped when they repeat the start's. Built by tools/lcc-outline; see data/schemes/lcc/SOURCES.md.
